officialText:
Section 604.12 revise to read as follows:

604.12 Uses Not Permitted. Manufactured wiring system types shall not be permitted where limited by the applicable article in Chapter 3 for the wiring method used in its construction. Manufactured wiring systems shall not be used for emergency exit signs or emergency lighting.
